subject: BlueArc vendor activation — banking rails preference and remit acceptance
messages:
From: Anna Li <anna@bluearc.com>
To: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.com>
Cc: 
Date: Fri, 01 Sep 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Vendor onboarding — BlueArc bank details and PO mapping

Hi Logan,

Thanks for the quick onboarding runbook earlier. We're ready to provide the bank details and W‑9 so your payments team can set BlueArc up as a payee. A few asks from our side:

- We prefer ACH (account on file) for recurring monthly settlements.
- We need to confirm how Redwood will present PO numbers on your remittance so our AR team can automatically reconcile. Ideally PO appears as "PO-12345" in the remittance reference.
- Can you confirm micro‑deposit verification or an alternative (e.g., ACH verification via Plaid)?

I'll attach our W‑9 now. Let me know if you need a banking letter or additional documentation.

Thanks,
Anna Li
Head of Finance, BlueArc Systems
anna@bluearc.com
[Attachment: BlueArc_W9.pdf (PDF)]

From: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.com>
To: Anna Li <anna@bluearc.com>
Cc: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 01 Sep 2028 10:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Vendor onboarding — BlueArc bank details and PO mapping

Hi Anna — great to hear. Looping in Jordan (FinOps) and Marissa (Vendor Ops) to coordinate the payment rail and PO mapping.

Quick answers up front:
- ACH preferred: yes, we can set BlueArc up for ACH settlements.
- PO labeling: we can map and require the PO# to be present in the invoice_reference field; our recommended label is "invoice_ref:PO-XXXXX". I put the mapping spec in the attached spreadsheet.
- Verification: we support both micro‑deposits (two small deposits) or instant verification via Plaid. Which do you prefer?

Attached: Redwood vendor onboarding form (please complete banking section) and our PO mapping spec. Once completed, Marissa will kick off the onboarding and Jordan will schedule the micro‑deposit test.

Next steps:
1) Anna: complete the attached PDF and return with bank letter if available.
2) Marissa: will create the vendor record and request micro‑deposits.
3) Jordan: will confirm expected settlement cadence and link PO rule-set to your account.

— Logan Wright
Sr. Procurement Partner, Redwood Inference
Logan.wright@redwood.com
[Attachment: redwood_vendor_onboarding_form.pdf (PDF)]

From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
To: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.com>, Anna Li <anna@bluearc.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 01 Sep 2028 12:47:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Vendor onboarding — BlueArc bank details and PO mapping

Hi all — Jordan from FinOps. A few implementation details and preferences from our side:

- For ACH we'll run two micro‑deposits (between $0.05–$0.99) to the account on file; we ask partners to confirm amounts after 24–48 hours. If you'd rather use Plaid instant verification, we can accept that and skip micro‑deposits.
- Settlement cadence: Net 30 by default for new partners; if you'd like Net 15 or custom cadence we can discuss under DEAL-4821.
- PO integration: To enable automatic reconciliation in BlueArc's AR system, we need the PO to be present in the "remittance_reference" and the invoice to have a separate "po_number" field. The attached xlsx shows the mapping we will apply programmatically.

Marissa — when Anna returns the filled PDF and bank details, please open Vendor Record #VA-4821 and tag with "PO‑auto ingest".

Anna — if you send the preferred verification route (micro‑deposits or Plaid) we'll proceed immediately.

Cheers,
Jordan Blake
FinOps Manager, Redwood Inference
jordan.blake@redwood.com
[Attachment: po_mapping_spec.xlsx (XLSX)]

From: Anna Li <anna@bluearc.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>, Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 02 Sep 2028 08:21:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Vendor onboarding — BlueArc bank details and PO mapping

Thanks Jordan — we'll do micro‑deposits to avoid sharing Plaid credentials. I completed the vendor form and attached it along with a scanned banking letter.

Expected timeline: we'll be able to confirm micro‑deposit amounts by Monday (Sep 4) morning. Our AR team confirmed they want the remittance reference exactly as "PO-" followed by the numeric PO (no extra text).

Attached: completed onboarding form + bank letter.

Best,
Anna
[Attachments: BlueArc_W9.pdf, BlueArc_Banking_Letter.pdf, completed_redwood_vendor_onboarding_form.pdf]

Hi Anna — all looks good, thank you for the fast turnaround. Confirming status and next steps:

- Vendor record VA-4821 created.
- Micro‑deposits were pushed today at 15:15 PDT from Redwood bank account (BANK: Redwood National Bank, routing: XXX000YYY, acct ending: 4321). Two test amounts were sent: $0.18 and $0.57.
- Once you confirm the amounts, I'll mark the account verified and set your default settlement to ACH, Net 30.
